title: Successor Update of Read Data
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input word, let $s$ be a natural number, let $c$ be a machine configuration on $x$, and let $i$ be a work-tape index. The read-data record at threshold $i+1$ is obtained from the record at threshold $i$ by updating its $i$th work-tape symbol entry to the symbol scanned by tape $i$, and its left- and right-edge entries to indicate respectively whether that tape's head is at $-s$ or at $s$.
